description: A React component for rendering detailed documentation and configuration options for a database connection in Apache Superset, including features, drivers, authentication, troubleshooting, and external resources.

classes.name: CodeBlock
classes.description: A React functional component that renders a styled code block for displaying connection strings or JSON data.

methods.name: renderConnectionString
methods.description: Renders a connection string with optional description inside a styled code block.

methods.name: renderDrivers
methods.description: Renders a tabbed interface displaying database drivers and their details.

methods.name: renderAuthMethods
methods.description: Displays authentication methods with collapsible details.

methods.name: renderEngineParams
methods.description: Displays engine parameters with collapsible sections.

methods.name: renderCompatibleDatabases
methods.description: Shows a list of compatible databases with connection info and parameters.

methods.name: renderFeatures
methods.description: Displays supported features as badges and feature score.

methods.name: renderTimeGrains
methods.description: Shows supported time grains, including common and extended.

methods.name: renderTroubleshooting
methods.description: Displays categorized troubleshooting/error messages with details.
